title: [AUG-184] Audit inline code comments with Comment Scanner
why_we_need_this: Inline code comments duplicate project knowledge that belongs in project-context and cost AI agents tokens every time they read the code. This task was created from the Boosts view; the scanner skill was written to `.agents/skills/comment-scanner/`.
acceptance_criteria:
- Follow `.agents/skills/comment-scanner/SKILL.md` and run the scanner on the project root.
- The user gets a short summary: total comments, estimated tokens, counts by type, the heaviest files and all TODO/FIXME/HACK markers.
- The full Markdown report is shared with the user.
- Cleanup candidates are proposed, with directive and license comments excluded.
- No comment is removed or rewritten without explicit user approval; knowledge worth keeping is moved into project-context first.
important_constraints:
- The scanner only reports; it never edits files.
- Keep tool directives (eslint, ts-expect-error, noqa, type: ignore), license headers, shebangs and encoding lines.
- Do not delete TODO/FIXME markers silently; offer to turn them into tasks.
